_comment: Sibling (closest-confusable) mapping for the E4c verifier's sibling-label contrast check.
Rule 1 (structural, computed at runtime, not listed here): every Level-1 value's siblings always include all other Level-1 values under the same official Level-2 category.

Rule 2 (extra_pairs below): curated cross-Level-2 pairs whose NAMES/DEFINITIONS in the official taxonomy overlap semantically. Curation is from taxonomy semantics only — no dev-set confusion statistics were used.
Pairs are symmetric; ids are official Level-1 ids as strings.
Validation (tests/test_families_and_siblings.py): every id is a valid Level-1 id, no self-pairs, and the runtime-merged map is symmetric.
